cells.gaps: No source found says whether any transfer goes without the CIL's authorisation, or that the CIL has published a list, model terms or a general authorisation.
cells.note: Rescored under Bill's ruling of 2026-10-31 (messages-for-bill 58): The CIL's authorisation form shows transfers abroad are conditioned on its permission [BFA-002]. Whether any transfer goes without it is not held, so the stage is 2. The form is a way to ask, not a way to send without asking [BFA-003].
